qa_pairs.question: What is a key benefit of using newer C++ compilers and standards?
qa_pairs.answer: A key benefit of using newer C++ compilers and standards is the ability to take full advantage of optimizations, particularly those resulting from features like `constexpr`. Newer standards also include updates to existing definitions that improve code correctness and/or enable additional optimizations.

qa_pairs.question: What happens if a developer uses an old C++ compiler or standard instead of newer available versions?
qa_pairs.answer: If a developer uses an old C++ compiler or an older standard when newer ones are available, they will not be able to take advantage of newer compiler abilities and C++ definitions, potentially missing out on improved code correctness and optimizations.
